it-mit2010.title: Muriel Médard, MIT OpenCourseWare 6.441 Information Theory (Spring 2010), lecture notes
it-mit2010.notes: AEP and typical sets (lecture 3), entropy of stochastic processes (lecture 4), source compression (lectures 5-7), channel coding and Fano converse (lectures 8-13).

it-mit2016.title: Yury Polyanskiy and Yihong Wu, MIT OpenCourseWare 6.441 Information Theory (Spring 2016), lecture notes
it-mit2016.notes: Source coding (chapters 6-9), entropy rates (chapter 5), channel coding (chapters 14-16), and rate-distortion theory (chapters 23-25).
